subject: general
question: According to February 2025 data, how many Khelo India Athletes were included in India's Paris 2024 Olympics contingent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**28**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A total of **28 athletes** from the Khelo India program were included in India's Paris 2024 Olympics contingent, as per February 2025 data.
 
• Khelo India is a flagship program launched by the Government of India to promote sports and identify young talent across the nation.
 
• The inclusion of Khelo India athletes in the Olympics highlights the success of the program in nurturing sports talent.
 
• The Khelo India initiative provides funding, training, and international exposure to promising athletes, helping them compete at the global level.
 
• The selected athletes come from diverse sports disciplines, showcasing India's growing strength across multiple categories in international competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India Program**

 
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports in 2018, the program aims to strengthen India's sports ecosystem.
 
• It includes initiatives such as the Khelo India Youth Games and Khelo India University Games.
 
• Under this program, selected athletes receive financial assistance of Rs. 5 lakh annually for training and development.
 
 
 
• **Paris 2024 Olympics**
 
 
• The Paris 2024 Olympics will be held from 26 July to 11 August 2024.
 
• It is the 33rd edition of the Summer Olympic Games, returning to Paris after 100 years (last hosted in 1924).
 
• The event will feature 32 sports and 329 events with athletes from over 200 nations.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Khelo India**
 
 
• The program has successfully identified and nurtured athletes from remote and underprivileged regions.
 
• It has contributed to the rise of medal-winning athletes in international competitions like the Olympics and Asian Games.
 
• The initiative aligns with India's vision of becoming a global sports powerhouse.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Selection Process**
 
 
• Athletes qualify for the Olympics through stringent national and international trials.
 
• Selection is based on performance in qualifying tournaments and adherence to international standards.
 
• Support programs like Khelo India play a vital role in preparing athletes for these trials.
